## Production go-live (2026-11-24, `main` @ 0aec7a7)
- **Rollback first (2026-11-23):** Northflank CD rolled `main` @ 8e0bd3c (V4) onto the V3 database, so the new API pod never passed readiness (`/health/ready` wants `alembic_version` = the code's head). With CI/CD off, `ecomsbd-api` and `ecomsbd-worker` went back to the existing 711f917 build `uplifting-trade-8387` without a rebuild, because an unpinned rebuild pulls sentry-sdk 3.0, which fails at startup with a DSN set. Sentry capped `<3` in PR #44 (3ef0595).
- **Migration `a39001` → `a48001` (2026-11-24 00:31 BDT):** read-only preflight (same database as the secret group's `DATABASE_URL`, 24 MB, no V4 table yet, no open transaction). Before writing: a `pg_dump` of `public` (709 KB, 118 tables), restored into a local PostgreSQL 17 and rehearsed (upgrade → downgrade `a39001` → upgrade, RLS on the new tables, data intact). Production: `alembic -x database-only=true upgrade head` once through the session pooler, 43 s in one transaction. Build `violet-guide-5699` (3ef0595, sentry-sdk 2.76) on `ecomsbd-api` and `ecomsbd-worker`. About 10–14 s of 503 on `/health/ready`; 32 orders / 50 tenants before and after.
- **Session pooler cap:** production `DATABASE_URL` is Supabase's session pooler (`:5432`), max 15 clients. The old API pod, a waiting V4 pod and the worker filled it (`EMAXCONNSESSION`), so "start V4, let it wait unready, then migrate" could not connect. Order that worked: API on the old build → deploy V4 → run the migration at once (it takes its slot before the new pod starts, ~30 s) → worker. Operator item below.
- **Web:** Cloudflare Worker `ecomsbd-web` version `74cac63a-5006-4445-b6b3-c4dfdb40f58a` from `main` @ 0aec7a7 (PR #45: next 16.4.6, @opennextjs/cloudflare 1.20.18, wrangler 4.166.0; `npm audit --omit=dev` 11 → 3 moderate), `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://api.ecomsbd.com/v1`. Twelve URLs answer as before the deploy. Rollback: `npx wrangler rollback f404a5de-f1f0-47e7-8dbf-a5f367321586` (3ef0595, next 16.4.2).
- **Domain move, server side:** secret group `PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://api.ecomsbd.com`, `PUBLIC_BASE_URL_ALIASES=https://api.scalemyprints.com`, `PUBLIC_WEB_URL=https://app.ecomsbd.com` (the other 86 values unchanged), then API and worker restarted. Both hosts answered 200 on every sample (46 of 46) during the restarts.
- **Still off, or still the operator's:** every V4 flag; Northflank CI/CD (the worker's source is pinned to `violet-guide-5699`); Meta and Supabase registrations; the phone and extension releases. See "Operator actions waiting".

- [ ] WATCH — Steadfast `live_verification` (run 12, 2026-11-25): when the first real Steadfast parcel booked by any shop gets a provider status recorded by the poller (`consignments` row with a provider status set by `poll_courier_statuses`), write `live_verification: {verified_at: <date>, evidence: "consignment <masked id>, status <seen>, poller"}` into `backend/app/couriers/manifests/steadfast.yaml` in a PR. Never from a test or a hand-made parcel. Until then Autopilot stays unavailable (`NOT_LIVE_VERIFIED`).
- [ ] Stuck real Steadfast parcel (found read-only in run 12, 2026-11-25): the only real Steadfast consignment in production (booked 2026-10-28 by shop `01a18256-445b-7a70-…`, raw status `in_review` from the booking answer) has `poll_failure_count` 11, last polled 2026-10-29, `next_poll_at` 2026-10-29 21:20 UTC: the poller stopped trying it, so its status has not moved in 4 weeks. Not touched (a real seller's data). Ask the seller whether the parcel shipped, check the shop's Steadfast credentials (`GET /v1/admin/ops/provider-health`, support bundle), and only then decide on a repair. It does not count for `live_verification` (no poller status).
- [ ] Web advisories left (2026-11-24): 3 moderate, all `glob` 13 / `minimatch` inside `@opennextjs/cloudflare`'s build CLI, not the Worker. Update when an OpenNext release allows `glob` ≥ 14.0.2.
- [x] Perf test decision (2026-11-18): keep every budget; tag `perf`, run alone in CI with `--concurrency=1`. Done.

## Decisions made during build (spec was silent)
- 2026-11-23 run 11 (domain): `PUBLIC_WEB_URL` = `https://app.ecomsbd.com`, not the apex: it builds the web return `/integrations/<id>` (a workspace route the apex 307s to `app.`) and the WhatsApp signup page, whose POSTs must come from exactly that origin. Customer confirm links `/c/<token>` are served on both hosts, so they follow it. The backend keeps no default (unset = features stay off); the value lives in `.env.production.example` and the runbook.
- 2026-11-23 run 11 (domain): no App Links were invented. The phone uses only `com.ecomsbd.app://auth/callback` and `://integrations/return`; there is no HTTPS intent filter, no associated domain and no `assetlinks.json` today (`docs/ANDROID_PACKAGE_MIGRATION.md`). Adding them is a feature with a release-key fingerprint, not a host move. `Env.webDashboardHost` had no caller; it was kept, moved to `app.`, and the legal host split out (`legalPagesHost`) because the two hosts serve different pages.
- 2026-11-23 run 11 (domain): the privacy policy sentence naming "the web platform at scalemyprints.com" (EN + BN) now names ecomsbd.com / app.ecomsbd.com: a factual host correction, no change to data practices; its "Last updated" was already 2026-11-23.
- 2026-11-23 run 10 (secret scan): a provider's published placeholder copied into a contract (`Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`) is allowlisted as that one literal in that one file, not rewritten out of history (the file's own rule). Every `.gitleaks.toml` entry with `paths` + `regexes` now says `condition = "AND"` — the gitleaks default "OR" let the path alone silence a whole file (a fake key at `backend/tests/test_config.py` passed the old config). Stricter only; full history still clean.
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6 (run 9): the contract comes from the JavaScript bundle `bdcourier.com/site/assets/index-DDbkeRIl.js` that renders `bdcourier.com/api-docs` — the provider's own domain and the page's own text (operator rule of run 5: official public docs from the provider's domain). Recorded with its sha256; the bundle is not committed (BD Courier's work).
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6: credentials are per shop (the existing seller-owned risk-provider connection), not the admin console used for Alpha SMS / voice: BD Courier's terms require each user's own key and forbid one account serving many clients. No platform key or env variable exists.
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6: "new order" for the terms' New Order Only rule = an order of the customer in DRAFT or CONFIRMED created within the last 3 days (not deleted). PACKED and later = past verification. Without one the lookup is SKIPPED `NEW_ORDER_REQUIRED`: nothing sent, no row, no daily-cap hit. A fresh cached answer is still served (no provider call).
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6: BD Courier's `risk_level` / `risk_verdict` ("AI-powered"), `success_ratio`, `reports` are dropped (the port carries counts, never a score; L9). `cancelled_parcel` stays `cancelled` in the courier history only, not mapped to RETURNED_PARCELS / CANCELLED_ORDERS (the page does not say which). Couriers with 0 parcels are left out; `summary.total_parcel` 0 = NOT_FOUND.
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6: the connection test is `GET /plans` (documented, no auth): it proves BD Courier answers, not the key — a test `/courier-check` would be a lookup without an order. So the spec does not claim `CONNECTION_TEST`; a wrong key surfaces on the first lookup as `PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED` (DOWN). The settings note says so in EN + BN.
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6: cache 1–72 h (default 24 h) and a 30-day keep (`retention_days`, pruned by the existing daily job) for the terms' "no permanent database"; other providers keep 180 days.
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6: the flag is a full kill switch: off hides the provider from the catalog, makes no lookup, hides stored answers, and stops them feeding `external_success_bps` and the confirmation policy (`external_history`). Built-in adapters are offered per shop through `registry.for_tenant`; `registry.available()` and `capability()`'s default still mean "registered", so the V3.7 gated tests are unchanged. Not changed: the workflow condition `external_data_state` (FRESH / STALE / NONE) still sees a stored BD Courier row while the flag is off; it carries no counts.
- 2026-11-23 WP0.6: the public privacy policy is not changed in code: it stays true while the flag is off everywhere; the new text is an operator go-live step (legal copy).
- 2026-11-23 WP7.1 (run 6): the "shop setting" for tracking SMS is the existing per-shop `messaging_channels` row for `SMS` (default off), not a new column; SMS is platform-available only while `active_sms_transport` returns the gateway (flag `alpha_sms_enabled` + console account). SMS templates carry order updates only (bulk / offer SMS needs a provider `content_id` the page does not describe) and must fit 3 parts (GSM / UCS-2 estimate) per language, because the provider states no maximum length or price. Campaigns stay EMAIL / WHATSAPP. Alpha `FAILED` (no connection, 417) = provably not sent → messaging `RETRY`; `UNKNOWN` and a crash while `SENDING` → `UNKNOWN`, never resent. No built-in SMS template (like WhatsApp): the seller saves one; the recipe step's default `order_update` key is the email one, as before.
- 2026-11-23 WP7.2: Carrybee has three credentials and courier accounts have two sealed slots (deliberately; no migration): Client-ID → first slot, Client-Secret + Client-Context sealed together as one JSON value in the second (`ProviderCredentialSpec.packed_secondary`); the connect route requires all three.
- 2026-11-23 WP7.2: create sends Normal (1) + Parcel (1), the free-text address, no city / zone / area ids (optional on the page; never guessed), default weight 500 g when the order has none (ecomsbd policy, as for RedX); a too-long address or merchant reference is refused locally, a long name / note is cut.
- 2026-11-23 WP7.2: `transfer_status` has no published values: kept verbatim, no state claim (Carrybee parcels do not move by polling until values are documented or seen live). Event mapping: picked → PICKED_UP; hub / warehouse / transit → IN_TRANSIT; assigned-for-delivery → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY; delivered → DELIVERED (final); partial-delivery → PARTIAL_DELIVERED (final, quantities by a person); returned / returned-at-sorting / returned-in-transit → RETURNING; returned-to-merchant → RETURNED (final); failed attempts, holds, pickup-cancelled, paid-return, exchange, paid, updated → no claim. Stored webhook events are not applied to parcel state (true for every courier today).
- 2026-11-23 WP7.2: three existing tests listed the exact provider set and now include Carrybee (same assertions, one more provider): test_courier_manifests EXPECTED_PROVIDERS, test_courier_multi bookable rows, test_rto excluded_providers. Neighbouring suites 243 run: these 2 failed on the new provider only, then green.
- 2026-11-23 WP7.2: the webhook replies 202 and echoes `X-CB-Webhook-Integration-Header` only after the shop's secret verified; an unknown token gets 202 "not active" (no oracle). Automatic booking recovery is Steadfast-only, so a Carrybee `BOOKING_UNKNOWN` is resolved by a person. Files are told apart by their bytes (RIFF/WAVE, ID3 or MPEG frame sync), ≤ 2 MiB; a WAV must be PCM and ≤ 60 s; an MP3's length is not measured. An MP3 is stored as uploaded at `intro-v<n>.mp3` (the spec names `.wav`; converting needs ffmpeg, not on the image). A draft already announced is never merged away. New column `chat_order_drafts.duplicate_of_order_id` (no FK, like `linked_customer_id`).

Its handler only logs ids/codes; the announcement moved out of `rebuild` so a draft merged in the same step is never announced.

Notification kind `DEVICE_NEEDS_ATTENTION` (category ORDERS, audience `settings.manage`, route `integrations`), at most once per device per 24 h via `config.stale_notified_at` (kept across recoveries, so a flapping phone does not re-notify).
